name: AMIN DIGITAL Attribute Groups for WooCommerce
author: AMIN DIGITAL

sections.description:
AMIN DIGITAL Attribute Groups for WooCommerce organises product attributes into separate, titled tables in WooCommerce’s existing Additional information tab. It keeps attributes as native WooCommerce attributes, so their values remain available to product filters and other WooCommerce features.

The plugin works on its own for display settings and manual group sets. Integrations with Icecat Data Importer and TD SYNNEX for WooCommerce are optional; when compatible integrations are active, their imported attribute groups can be shown automatically.

Features

  • Display attribute groups as separate titled tables or compact lists.
  • Keep ungrouped visible attributes in WooCommerce’s standard attribute table.
  • Create reusable group sets for global WooCommerce attributes and choose a default set.
  • Choose a group set on an individual product.
  • View and rename groups imported by Icecat, TD SYNNEX, or the product capture workflow.
  • Configure group order, dimensions and weight, headings, and table colours.
  • Display grouped attributes with a shortcode: [amin_product_attribute_groups id=”123″] or [amin_product_attribute_groups ids=”123,456″ layout=”compact”].
  • Override the display template at woocommerce/amin-wc-attribute-group.php in your theme.
  • Duplicate a global WooCommerce attribute and its terms.

Support

Developed by AMIN GHASEMI for AMIN DIGITAL. WordPress.org profile: https://profiles.wordpress.org/amindigital/. Company website: https://amindigital.uk.

Third-party software

The administration interface includes Bootstrap 5.3.9, distributed under the MIT License. The licence notice is included in assets/BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE.txt. Bootstrap source code: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.9.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  3. Open Products > Attribute Groups to configure the display and create reusable group sets.
  4. For imported groups, optionally install and activate compatible versions of Icecat Data Importer or TD SYNNEX for WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Icecat or TD SYNNEX?

No. The plugin can display and manage attribute groups by itself. Icecat and TD SYNNEX integrations are optional.

Does it create a separate product attribute taxonomy?

No. It displays existing WooCommerce product attributes in titled groups and preserves their native attributes and values.

Where do grouped attributes appear?

They appear in the WooCommerce product page’s Additional information tab. The shortcode can also display attributes for selected products on a page or template.
